Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism action_type 'BLOCKER'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Left join compound_structures on molregno. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target chembl_id as target_chembl_id, and target pref_name as target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
